items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Wooden Joe' Nicholas and Fred, but the mention of Kempern is solely in response to an interviewer's question comparing Kempern to Joe. The interviewee does not describe any personal interaction, relationship, or direct knowledge of Kempern beyond acknowledging the comparis

ctx.x: Fred could make himself. He could be Joe.
Was Kempern as powerful a horn?

Yeah, a horn. Yeah, a horn. It was powerful in Joe, I believe it was. Yeah, it was powerful. Yeah, it was powerful. And he never did play soft, like we would do, but it sounds, it's got a good tone, you know? And this guy could blow. See, see, the only one he fell is bunk. He told me that many times. He said, bunk, I said, he was right. The old bunk, we'd be up in the corner, we'd buy a stuff, and I'd be all set in my life, all time sleeping. He'd never go home, you know? That was rough. He'd drink all the time…
